gen-audiowide-gf-aclonica: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide draws every curve as a uniform wire, while Aclonica, a plain sans, loosens up with a mild stroke swing. Wire against friendly.
gen-audiowide-gf-allerta: Allerta keeps its letters wide and loosely tracked, with a prominent x-height. Audiowide supplies the one thing it lacks, a futuristic tile-like heading with strokes that never thin or swell.
gen-audiowide-gf-alumni-sans: Alumni Sans has short ascenders and a wide-open c, with a measured swell from hairline to stem. Audiowide holds its strokes uniform from stem to terminal, and the two sit together like machine and hand.
gen-audiowide-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Wide-grouted, tile-like glyphs with no thick-thin shift make Audiowide look like a futuristic control panel. Alumni Sans Pinstripe, a sans-serif with tight word texture and oversized lowercase beside small capitals, would read in a dense, approachable stream.
gen-audiowide-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Squeezed and contemporary, with lowercase that towers over its own capitals, this body is a tight read. Audiowide does its best work as a tube-like futuristic heading, while Alumni Sans SC, a sans-serif, brings a slight wedge-pen pressure to each curve.
gen-audiowide-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs rounded, side-open forms into a dense line that the eye slides through, much like a plain sans with big lowercase. Audiowide earns its keep big and short.
gen-audiowide-gf-arsenal: Arsenal brings an x-height near cap height and a close-knit line with a faint stroke modulation. Arsenal, a sans-serif, reads as a quiet hum beside Audiowide's flat, constant-weight lines.
gen-audiowide-gf-arsenal-sc: Tile-like glyphs and perfectly flat joints make Audiowide look cut from one sheet. Arsenal SC, a plain sans, counters with gently swelling curves, a tight fit and a wide mouth.
gen-audiowide-gf-asimovian: Tall, tech-flavored and unfussy. Audiowide's wide-grouted tiles lead the way, and Asimovian follows with tall lowercase built from one stroke width, which would feel oddly big if the heading were made small.
gen-audiowide-gf-basic: Professional and clean, Basic, a plain sans, lifts only gently from small letters to capitals beneath Audiowide's tube-like futuristic heading. Leave its size modest.
